authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: Validation is not deferred: unit, integration, generation, scoped whitespace, build, browser, accessibility, and negative-control checks declared by the Work Pack remain mandatory.
Candidate-local prototype evidence grants no ontology authority and proves no promotion, publication, deployment, release, or production readiness.
Do not delete, rewrite, or absorb historical Understand Anything locks, patches, receipts, builds, or other pre-existing evidence.
Do not treat this notice, its locator, or a passing prototype report as permission to perform lifecycle reconciliation, Git publication, external delivery, deployment, or authority changes.
Reconciliation must be derived from terminal source receipts and the consolidated validation report; do not manufacture missing per-SWU results or silently mark unexecuted units complete.
Preserve unrelated dirty-checkout bytes and record unattributed overlap separately.
key_points: WP-SOEW-001 whole-pack implementation is proceeding as a candidate-local prototype without pauses for per-SWU Invoke Refresh, Task Session admission, closeout synchronization, or continuation routing.

The implementation lane must preserve the approved dependency order, declared product scopes, semantic and privacy boundaries, and every unit's validation; any acceptance-critical failure stops the frontier.
The lane must retain terminal source receipts and emit one consolidated prototype validation report so a future lifecycle owner can reconcile the Work Pack from evidence rather than inference.

Understand Anything may be removed only from active execution after the full Body War browser acceptance unit passes. Historical upstream locks, patches, receipts, and prior builds must remain unchanged and unreachable from active execution.

The approved Work Pack and Refine result describe 21 atomic SWUs, while the Execution Pack wave table and choreography still contain stale 15-unit wording; the future lifecycle owner must verify the machine manifest and executed receipts before repairing that planning projection.
This notice records communication evidence only. It is not implementation, lifecycle closeout, ontology authority, promotion, publication, deployment, release, or production-readiness evidence.
